templates.narrative: Granted HAA for CAT-III @ R1H1 rate from {rejoin_on} for {station}

slots.label: Station code
slots.help: The station code from the master list of location codes.

slots.label: HAA: name of Corps
slots.help: The Corps whose notification lists the unit for HAA.

slots.label: HAA: notification no. and date
slots.help: Number and date of the Corps notification that lists the unit for HAA.

slots.label: HAA: serial in the notification
slots.help: The serial at which the unit appears in that notification.

slots.label: Last day of the absence
slots.help: The last day of the leave, hospital stay or course itself, not counting any suffix.

slots.label: Last suffix day
slots.help: A weekend or holiday joined to the end of the absence. Enter the last such day, or leave blank; the slip then prints Nil.

slots.label: Rejoining day
slots.help: The day after the last day away. Worked out for you.

templates.certificate: CERTIFICATE : HAA ALLOWANCE ON POSTING / TEMPORARY DUTY (CONTINUOUS PERIOD OF MORE THAN 14 DAYS) TO QUALIFYING AREAS i.
